    frame=frame*(1-ra[:,:,None])+r
    frame=frame*(1-pm[:,:,None])+paper*pm[:,:,None]
    frame=cv2.resize(frame,(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    return np.clip(frame,0,255)

def main():
    model0=render(0)
    correction=img-model0
    frames=[original]
    for i in range(1,20):
        t=i/4
        frame=render(t)
        # Preserve the exact source appearance as the first small movement begins.
        frame+=correction*np.exp(-4.3*t)
        frames.append(np.clip(np.rint(frame),0,255).astype(np.uint8))
        print('frame',i,flush=True)
    artifact_io.save(np.stack(frames),ROOT)
